description: Finds a site's sitemap (from robots.txt, else /sitemap.xml) or checks the sitemap URL given, and validates it: urlset vs sitemapindex, entry count against the 50,000 limit, lastmod format and range, relative/off-host/duplicate/http URLs, gzip support. Returns sample URLs or child sitemaps. Deterministic, no AI. Price: $0.002 USDC per call via x402 (Base); the first 5 calls per day per client are free.

url.description: Site URL (discovers the sitemap) or a sitemap URL

name: sitemap_check
title: Find and validate an XML sitemap
